description: This file contains the implementation of the MediaKeysIpcTestBase class, which provides setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeys IPC interactions, including creating/destroying IPC objects, subscribing/unsubscribing to events, and handling responses in a media key management context.

classes.name: MediaKeysIpcTestBase
classes.description: A base class providing common setup, teardown, and utility functions for testing MediaKeys IPC interactions, including managing event subscriptions, creating/destroying IPC instances, and handling responses.

methods.name: createMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Initializes the MediaKeys IPC object, setting up necessary mocks and expectations.

methods.name: destroyMediaKeysIpc
methods.description: Cleans up and destroys the MediaKeys IPC object, unsubscribing from events.

methods.name: expectSubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for subscribing to specific IPC events and assigns handlers.

methods.name: expectUnsubscribeEvents
methods.description: Sets expectations for unsubscribing from IPC events.

methods.name: createKeySession
methods.description: Creates a new key session and sets up the response handling.

methods.name: createLicenseRenewalEvent
methods.description: Constructs a LicenseRenewalEvent message with current data.

methods.name: setCreateMediaKeysResponse
methods.description: Sets the media keys handle in the create media keys response message.

methods.name: setCreateKeySessionResponseSuccess
methods.description: Sets the key session ID and error status in the create key session response message.

methods.name: convertMediaKeyErrorStatus
methods.description: Converts internal MediaKeyErrorStatus enum to protobuf error status.
